rows.title: Shipping generator; no active work
rows.detail: dharmatiles-gen builds the library tiles from src/tiles/. It stays the shipping code until the Rust cutover (P6).

rows.title: Phase 0 spikes: decided GO (2 Nov 2026)
rows.detail: R1, R2, R3, R6 and R9 passed. Determinism level B chosen, contact sheet approved, no vetoes. Branch rust/p0, revision 8 of the study.

rows.title: Round 17 accepted
rows.detail: Crisp sparse chips, bold column setbacks, closed core holes (31f7c5d on main).

rows.title: Look pages done, audience first
rows.detail: All eight look pages (ground, grass, rocks, cliffs, water, walls, trees, composition) open with the look, its use in a tile and its specification; rulings, requirements, reference photos and history sit lower in a design record. Home and standards pages lead with what a tile user needs.

rows.title: Docs follow-ups done: 55° audits, live doc paths, red-painted renders
rows.detail: rocklab/grasslab/dirtlab audit at 55° (clifflab face report reads the constant); ~40 dead docs/ paths in code repointed; red-overhang heroes on trees, walls and composition; variants page images fixed; 0 broken links.

rows.title: Phase 1 done: flat tile prints from Rust
rows.detail: Merged into main (84056d8). Flat 1×1 DB tile: watertight, 0 overhang, 0.1 s, same hashes on macOS and Linux; review findings fixed; Shawn's test print seated and the contact-sheet layout is approved.

rows.title: Phase 2 done: dirt signed off and merged
rows.detail: Shawn: “dirt is beautiful”. Rust dirt matches dirtlab at seeds 1–4 (texture 97.8%, clods/pebbles/spectrum within tolerance, 0.8 s, 0 overhang). soil-1x1.kdl replaces 1x1-soil.tile.py; flat test tile now a 3.4 mm slab.

rows.title: Phase 3 done: rocks and water signed off and merged
rows.detail: Shawn, 3 Nov: 'let's just keep going'. Rocks and water pass parity at seeds 1–4; eleven water twins are in library/tiles/water and their .tile.py files are deleted. Later: dirt-stones 10–40 mm spectrum 1.203 vs ±20%; rocks texture 88–93% vs the lab's 95–97%.

rows.title: Phase 5 done: walls, floors, OpenLOCK and trees merged
rows.detail: Shawn, 3 Nov: 'yeah, trees suck. But they're really hard. So let's just keep going.' Trees accepted for now. Floors twins in; floor .tile.py deleted. Later: wall openings, floor crack engraving, the mortar sheet, tree quality.

rows.title: Phase 4 grass: parity passes, waiting for Shawn
rows.detail: Blades 3397 vs lab 3368 (+0.9%), mean top 1.27 mm vs 1.20, rounder tips; fieldstone walls stand by construction (seeds 1-16 pass at db and ol); meadow/grass/shore seeds 4-40 all pass the gate. Waiting on Shawn: sheets (out/parity/grass/contact-sheet.png) and a print.

rows.title: Items that need Shawn's eye or permission
rows.detail: 1. Grass/meadow/shore/flowers sheets (out/parity/grass/contact-sheet.png; flowers tile lib:tiles/ground/1x1-grass-flowers.kdl) and a meadow print. 2. The cliff slice: look at lib:tiles/cliffs/2x1-cliff.kdl (build --png) and say how far to take it. 3. Open a .3mf in Bambu Studio.

rows.title: Phase 6 cutover done; v0.1.0 released
rows.detail: Python specs, dharmatiles-gen and stl/ deleted; python-library-final tagged; flowers ported. Release v0.1.0 (macOS arm64) published on GitHub, with the Homebrew tap shawn-vincent/homebrew-dharmatiles (brew install shawn-vincent/dharmatiles/dharmatiles).

rows.title: Phase 7: frozen at round 17; first slice of the cliff builds
rows.detail: Foot moved to 3.4 mm; cliff look (straight run: masses, tiers, end section, stacked stones, grain, core) passes the gate at 8 seeds, both systems, ~1 s; all 44 library tiles build. Not clifflab's look yet: no crack network, shattered patches, bank, scree, other forms; parity numbers not measured.

rows.title: Phase 8: 3MF + palette, MCP (stdio and HTTP), language server in
rows.detail: dharmatiles build --3mf --palette; mcp --http; lsp (diagnostics, hover, completion). Not started: Tauri app, wasm, mobile.

rows.title: dharmatiles preview: progress bar, ortho toggle, eased views, inertia, sky and grid
rows.detail: Build progress with ETA (timing cache) in preview and on the CLI; ortho/perspective; eased orbit; fling momentum; sky background; grid at z=0. Next: section cuts, measuring, per-entry updates.

rows.title: Library tiles renamed to the naming standard
rows.detail: NxM first (soil, cliff, water+grass-tree, all test tiles); a library test now enforces <NxM>-<name>.kdl and that the size matches the document. Tile names inside documents are unchanged so seeds and hashes are too.
